notes.title: 🌳💸 My Money Grows On Trees – OUT NOW! 💸🌳
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello Money Farmers! 👋[/b][/h3]

The wait is over! [b]My Money Grows On Trees has just been released! 🚀[/b]
 Click, water, grow, harvest, explore, upgrade… and yes, finally watch your very own money trees flourish! 🌱✨

[previewyoutube=p3_GQagmBPo;full][/previewyoutube]

We can’t wait to hear your thoughts, feedback, and stories about how your farms are growing. Whether you’re playing solo or jumping into online co-op with friends, your journey to the richest orchard begins today! 🌳💵

💬 Share your impressions with us. your feedback helps us make the game even better!
 🎮 Grab your watering can and let’s grow together!

See you soon,
[b]My Money Grows On Trees Team[/b]

notes.title: My Money Grows On Trees — Launching August 21!
notes.notes:
[p]Get ready to enter an exciting world where your money doesn’t just grow—it thrives on trees!
Plant, nurture, and watch your financial empire bloom in this minimalist farming incremental simulation game! Whether you're a casual gamer or a strategy fan, this game will offer something special for everyone.  We can’t wait for you to experience the fun, challenges, and surprises waiting for you in [b]My Money Grows On Trees[/b]. Make sure to mark your calendars and join us for the launch!

Stay tuned for sneak peeks, trailers, and exclusive content coming your way soon! ✨

[b]See you soon,
My Money Grows On Trees Team[/b][/p]
